# denseui

> Ultra-dense, modern UI components for React, built on Tailwind CSS v4 and Ark UI. Components are copied into the project with `npx denseui@latest add <name>` and imported from `@/components/ui/<name>`. 24px controls, 13px body text, semantic color tokens, light/dark via the `.dark` class.

Read the design guidelines before generating UI. An MCP server is available: `npx denseui@latest mcp`.

## Docs

- [Design guidelines](guidelines.md): density, color tokens, component choice and rules
- [Theme tokens](tokens.css): every CSS variable and Tailwind theme value
- [Full docs](llms-full.txt): guidelines plus every component with example and source

## Inputs

- [Button](react/button.md): 24px button with default, outline, ghost, subtle, destructive and link variants
- [Button Group](react/button-group.md): Joins related buttons into one control
- [Input](react/input.md): Compact text input
- [Input Group](react/input-group.md): Input with icons, text or buttons attached
- [Input OTP](react/input-otp.md): One-time password input
- [Password Input](react/password-input.md): Password field with show/hide toggle
- [Number Input](react/number-input.md): Numeric input with steppers, min/max and formatting
- [Textarea](react/textarea.md): Auto-growing textarea
- [Label](react/label.md): Muted form label
- [Field](react/field.md): Form field layout with label, description and error
- [Form](react/form.md): react-hook-form bindings with accessible labels, descriptions and error messages
- [Checkbox](react/checkbox.md): 14px checkbox with indeterminate state
- [Radio Group](react/radio-group.md): Radio group
- [Switch](react/switch.md): Small toggle switch
- [Select](react/select.md): Custom select with groups and check indicator
- [Native Select](react/native-select.md): Styled native select element
- [Combobox](react/combobox.md): Searchable input with a list of suggestions
- [Tags Input](react/tags-input.md): Multi-value tag input with stable per-tag colors
- [Slider](react/slider.md): Range slider with one or more thumbs
- [Rating](react/rating.md): Star rating input
- [Toggle](react/toggle.md): Two-state button
- [Toggle Group](react/toggle-group.md): Set of toggles, single or multiple selection
- [Segmented Control](react/segmented-control.md): Single-choice segmented switcher with a sliding indicator
- [Calendar](react/calendar.md): Inline date grid with day, month and year views
- [Date Picker](react/date-picker.md): Date input with a calendar popover
- [Color Picker](react/color-picker.md): Color input with saturation area, hue/alpha sliders, eyedropper and presets
- [File Upload](react/file-upload.md): Drag-and-drop dropzone with file list and image previews
- [Editable](react/editable.md): Click-to-edit inline text, like a page title

## Overlays

- [Dialog](react/dialog.md): Modal dialog

- [Sheet](react/sheet.md): Side panel that slides in from any edge

- [Popover](react/popover.md): Floating panel
- [Hover Card](react/hover-card.md): Preview content when hovering a link
- [Tooltip](react/tooltip.md): Dark compact tooltip
- [Dropdown Menu](react/dropdown-menu.md): Dropdown and context menu with submenus, checkbox and radio items
- [Context Menu](react/context-menu.md): Menu opened by right-click
- [Menubar](react/menubar.md): Desktop-style horizontal menu bar
- [Command](react/command.md): Keyboard-first command menu, inline or as a ⌘K dialog
- [Toast](react/toast.md): Stacked notifications with types and actions

- [Sidebar](react/sidebar.md): Collapsible app sidebar with groups, menus and sub-menus

- [Navigation Menu](react/navigation-menu.md): Site navigation with dropdown panels

- [Property](react/property.md): Label/value property rows for record details

- [Badge](react/badge.md): Colored tag using the 10-color palette

- [Avatar](react/avatar.md): 20px avatar with fallback
- [Alert](react/alert.md): Callout for important information, with info, success, warning and destructive variants
- [Callout](react/callout.md): Highlighted note with an emoji or icon
- [Empty](react/empty.md): Empty state with icon, title and actions
- [Progress](react/progress.md): Thin progress bar
- [Spinner](react/spinner.md): Loading spinner
- [Skeleton](react/skeleton.md): Loading placeholder
- [Carousel](react/carousel.md): Swipeable slides with controls and indicators
